relocated_files / relocated_labels are a LEGACY-DEBT inventory, not permission or precedent. NEW RELOCATIONS ARE FORBIDDEN.
Every pret counterpart belongs at dos_port/src/<pret path>; move legacy entries back to their mirrors when touched.
structural_findings records audited legacy violations as OPEN debt, never precedent or authority for new work.
Agents may not add entries or edit either category to make their own lint failure pass; registry edits may only retire/reclassify debt and the exact file hash is approved outside the worktree.
Legacy entries began as a 2026-07-07 full-tree inventory and remain subject to structural audit.

DiscardButtonPresses.why: pret engine/joypad.asm is the REJECTED faithful-input model and is DEAD (in no Makefile SRCS list, and unlinkable: it ends in `jmp Joypad`, which the port never defines). The port's live input model is the src/input/joypad.asm HAL, which polls from the DelayFrame pipeline - the documented port-input-model DEVIATION (pret's `call Joypad` has no port counterpart). DiscardButtonPresses is model-neutral (it just zeroes hJoyHeld/hJoyPressed/hJoyReleased) and was ALREADY live here, inlined as the local label `.discard`; overworld-events Stage 4 extracted it into a real global because DoBoulderDustAnimation calls it. Permanent while the port-input-model deviation stands.

suppress.why: documented DEVIATION integration stub: arms menu vars (wMaxMenuItem etc.) so PCMainMenu dispatch runs on defined state — minimal contract, no box draw

DECISION-FOR-USER (Session H): full faithful body lives in core_stubs.asm because misc.asm is check-only and its GetName dep isn't link-ready; should move to a non-stub file or ride misc.asm's promotion
known interim: core_stubs.asm body is linked; misc.asm's is check-only (BATTLE_SRCS). Resolve with the non_ret_stub decision above

known interim (overworld-events Stage 3): hidden_object_stubs.asm ret-stub is linked (a HiddenEventMaps handler for Game Corner slot tiles); the real body in engine/slots/game_corner_slots.asm is unlisted (in no Makefile SRCS list). Delete the stub when game_corner_slots.asm is promoted to a linked list (Stage 5 Celadon)

NOT the silent-shadow trap this rule targets: only ONE definition is linked. src/input/joypad.asm (HAL_SRCS) holds the live body; src/engine/joypad.asm is DEAD - in no SRCS list at all (not even a check-only one), so it is never assembled and cannot shadow anything. It is retained solely as a cross-reference to pret's original input routine (_Joypad/ReadJoypad_/TrySoftReset) for a future faithful-input pass, and its header says so. Retire this entry by deleting engine/joypad.asm, or by dropping its DiscardButtonPresses copy, if that reference is ever cashed in or abandoned (overworld-events Stage 4).
